_about: Golden cases for the configuration YAML subset (yamlcore.py / yaml.rs). Values are rendered canonically: null, true/false, integers in decimal, floats as Python repr, strings with the shared quote rule, [a, b] and {"k": v} in document order. Both unit-test suites load this file.

cases.name: core scalars
cases.text:
a: ~
b: null
c:
d: true
e: False
f: 0o17
g: 0x1F
h: -12
i: 1.5
j: .5
k: 1e3
l: 007
m: yes
n: on
o: 0b101
p: '1'
q: "x"

cases.name: explicit tags
cases.text:
a: !!str 12
b: !!int '5'
c: !!float 1
d: !!bool true
e: !!null
f: !!seq [a]
g: !!map {a: b}

cases.name: block and flow
cases.text:
allow:
- git
- gh
other: [x, {y: z}, "q"]
m:
  n: [1,
    2]

cases.name: compact sequences
cases.text:
- - a
  - b
- k: v
  j: w
-
  - deep

cases.name: quoting and escapes
cases.text:
a: 'it''s'
b: "t\tu\u00e9\U0001F600\x41\N\_\L\P\e\0"
c: url://h/p?x=1#frag
d: x #comment
'quoted key': 1
